name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A rulebook you give your AI coding assistant so the websites it builds stop looking like every other generic AI-made site (same purple gradient, same rounded icon box) and instead look like something a real designer made.
buyer: A solo founder or small agency shipping client websites with AI coding tools who is embarrassed that every site they ship looks the same.
business_use_cases: A freelance web developer runs '/impeccable polish' on a client site before delivery so it doesn't scream 'made with AI'.
A no-code agency standardizes every new build on this skill so junior staff produce consistent, non-templated design without a dedicated designer.
An indie SaaS founder uses it to redesign their landing page before a product launch instead of hiring a $3k design contractor.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a flat-fee 'de-AI-ify your site' service: run the skill against a client's existing AI-built site and deliver a polished before/after.
Sell a premium pack of additional visual-direction presets (brutalist, editorial, luxury) on top of the free base skill.

steal_this: This weekend, build a one-page 'AI slop checker': paste a URL, run the detector rules, and show a public shareable report card grading the site's design clichés — then upsell the fix.
